fabric.name: declared-light-cotton-poplin-estimate
notes: These are declared physical estimates for a light cotton poplin, not swatch-calibrated measurements, so no run using them may claim calibrated fabric or accepted cloth.

The source bundle's fabric document is expressed in the Warp and Style3D solver's own parameterization (garment_tri_ka, spring_ke, and similar), which has no direct continuum equivalent. Only its friction coefficient of 0.35 transfers unchanged and is used below.
Membrane stiffness is the product of the Young's modulus and the thickness: 1.0 MPa times 0.34 mm gives 340 N/m, inside the usual woven-fabric range of roughly 100 to 1000 N/m.
Areal density follows from the same thickness: 380 kg/m3 times 0.34 mm gives 0.129 kg/m2, a light shirting weight.

The envelope matches the accepted arrangement schedule v5 so the settle starts from a state its own contact model already considers valid, and so the resting contact distance stays above the 0.25 cm clearance acceptance threshold.

The assembly used a deliberately soft 100 N/m so panels could glide around the body without a teleporting first step. The garment now arrives sewn, so the seams travel almost nothing and a stiffer 10 kN/m holds them closed against gravity without reintroducing that approach-speed problem.

equilibrium.rule: The settle ends when no vertex moves more than the declared distance for the declared number of consecutive frames. Reaching the frame budget without that streak is recorded as not settled rather than treated as equilibrium.
